title: Pool off the lower level
content: If you go down to the lower level, then go off one of those creepy side branches, you'll find a door labelled "Pool" and there's actually a full locker and shower room system and a full-sized Olympic pool! Within the mall! I had no idea until last night but yea, it's a full sized 25m x 25 yd pool. Only difference is you swim while gliding completely on top of the water somehow, instead of slightly below. I was on a swim team in my youth and forgot all about it, but I was surprised to find the pool down there and I got to try competitive swimming again, even if I was just floating on top.
